exceptions.description: SDK-only paths (packages/sdk, sdks/mcp-server, packages/arkova-py) force T2 with no override label per memory/project_sdk_paths_are_hard_t2.md, but an SDK-only PR deploys nothing — there is no worker/rig surface to soak. Founder-granted exception: record the exception rather than fabricate a soak.

The JWT-gated HTTP routes for these PRs (POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/keys*, POST /api/v1/integrations/google_drive/oauth/start) require a Supabase user JWT in the same Authorization header Cloud Run's own IAM check consumes on this --no-allow-unauthenticated service — the two cannot coexist in one header. This is a pre-existing limitation of every IAM-protected rig in this repo (docs/reference/STAGING_RIG.md already documents it for the shared arkova-worker-staging rig: 'JWT-protected client paths aren't load-tested by the soak harness'), not introduced by or specific to Wave 3. Underlying business logic for all three was proven directly against real rig data instead (see docs/staging/wave3-2026-08/soak-start-2026-08-20.md per-member evidence); the HTTP transport layer itself was not round-tripped.
